text: One for the tracker: What is the ticket number for the West yard Door 2 double-booking at Marrow Fieldworks? Need it before the customer call.
reply_text:
I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-random message: the ticket is **#8841**.

- **Where it came from:** Tobias posted in #central-random yesterday (Oct 13, 9:27) that West yard Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk. He said he'd flagged it to support on #8841. Pree is in that channel, so she could see it herself.
- **One assumption:** Tobias called it "Tobias's dealer account" and didn't name Marrow Fieldworks. I'm treating them as the same account because a public Central handoff note says Marrow Fieldworks, Pree's dealer account, changed hands on Jan 5. I told Pree this and suggested she check with Tobias before the call. I also warned her not to mix it up with #88412, an older Tansleigh Packaging ticket.
- **gbrain didn't work:** it refused every search because its access token isn't tied to any member, so it read nothing. I answered from the world tools only, using what Pree can see. To fix it, an admin on the brain's host needs to run `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member <member>`. A shared bot like this one could instead be set up with `--may-act-for`. I didn't try to change the access myself.
